defect: clock-timeout threshold depends on an unstated external clock relationship
rationale: The two clocks are independently synchronized for the observation handshake, but the RTL does not state the allowed check-clock frequency range or the board's stopped-clock timeout contract; the chosen periods and threshold cannot establish whether timeout_o is correct.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the timeout primitive to a check-clock toggle, a reference-domain synchronizer, and a saturating timeout counter.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Async groups over a toggle 2FF crossing into ref_clk, I/O on ref_clk.

The 9 ns check-clock period and 10 ns reference period do not establish the external allowed clock range or stopped-clock detection requirement. Structural synchronization alone cannot justify the timeout timing contract.

settled_by: Third reading: gpt-6.1-sol; The 9 ns check-clock period and 10 ns reference period do not establish the external allowed clock range or stopped-clock detection requirement. Structural synchronization alone cannot justify the timeout timing contract.
